search_text: published ZDI-17-832 ZDI-CAN-4760 Hewlett Packard Enterprise Intelligent Management Center WebDMDebugServlet Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2017-10-03 CVE-2017-12557 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-12557 10.0 ['Hewlett Packard Enterprise'] ['Intelligent Management Center'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Intelligent Management Center. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the WebDMDebugServlet, which listens on TCP ports 8080 and 8443 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Hewlett Packard Enterprise has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://h20564.www2.hpe.com/hpsc/doc/public/display?docId=emr_na-hpesbhf03778en_us ['2017-05-04 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2017-10-03 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Steven Seeley (mr_me) of Offensive Security https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-17-832/
